nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; mutated without SafeMath inside transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances; set to uint(-1) in constructor and mutated in approve/transferFrom.
Total token supply, initialized to 140736000000000000000000000 and used in the list() mint calculation.
Private privileged address set in the constructor; used as the access-control anchor in checkLimits, delegate and list.
Uniswap pair address derived in the constructor via pairFor and whitelisted in checkLimits.
Hard-coded Uniswap V2 router address used as external call target in list().
Hard-coded Uniswap factory address used for CREATE2 pair-address derivation.
Hard-coded WETH address used as the other token in the liquidity pair.
Constant decimals value (18) exposed as public metadata.
Public token name string 'Yield Protocol'.
Public token symbol string 'YIELD'.
Constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, derives uniPair via pairFor and grants unlimited allowances to the router and the sender/pair.
Payable transfer entry point that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom guarded by the checkLimits modifier; performs raw (unchecked) allowance and balance arithmetic and mutates balances.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval; no zero-address or race protection.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata.
Modifier gating transferFrom; relies on tx.origin == owner (phishing/tx.origin authorization flaw) as well as msg.sender, uniPair and owner comparisons.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address with CREATE2 keccak256 derivation; no input validation on the addresses.

Owner-only payable function that overwrites arbitrary balances, mints 6% to the owner, calls addLiquidityETH on the router with a block.timestamp deadline and loops over user-supplied recipients/amounts.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance approvals and balance updates.
Transaction originator used as an authorization condition in checkLimits, enabling phishing-based bypass.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used to build the Uniswap deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list().
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker/owner-supplied bytecode in the token's storage context.
External payable call into the Uniswap router (addLiquidityETH) executed while balances are being written, with an unvalidated return.
Raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath (Solidity ^0.7 wraps silently).
Raw allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath, allowing unchecked wrap-around.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account.
Constructor writes the owner state variable that gates delegate() and list().
Constructor invokes pairFor() to derive uniPair.
Constructor stores the derived pair address into uniPair.
Constructor grants unlimited allowances (address(this)->router and msg.sender->pair).
Constructor reads uniFactory to compute the pair address.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument.
transferFrom is gated by the checkLimits modifier.
checkLimits authorizes when tx.origin == owner, allowing phishing-based bypass of caller checks.
checkLimits also compares msg.sender to owner as an authorization condition.
checkLimits reads the owner state variable for its equality checks.
checkLimits whitelists the uniPair address, bypassing balance restrictions for pool transfers.
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from to decide whether to spend an allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic.
transferFrom performs unchecked -= and += on balances, causing integer underflow/overflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked -= on the allowance mapping.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approve() overwrites the allowance mapping entry for the spender.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner.
delegate() reads owner for its authorization check.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall to the supplied address and calldata.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before mutating balances.
list() reads owner for its authorization check and mints 6% of supply to it.
list() arbitrarily overwrites balanceOf entries for address(this), msg.sender and every _tos element.
list() uses totalSupply to compute balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply * 6 / 100.
list() derives the Uniswap deadline from block.timestamp + 600, making execution miner-influenceable.
list() performs an external router call while balance state is being rewritten in the following loop.
list() uses uniRouter as the external call target.
pairFor() returns the CREATE2 pair address stored into uniPair.
pairFor() embeds the factory address in the pair derivation hash.
The addLiquidityETH call targets the uniRouter state variable.
The unchecked balance mutation directly writes the balanceOf state variable.
The unchecked allowance decrement directly writes the allowance state variable.
